001package pkg_entities;
002
003import java.util.HashMap;
004import java.util.Stack;
005
006/**
007 * Stores the state that belongs to the player: identity, current position, history, and a personal
008 * item list.
009 *
010 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
011 * @version 2026.04.13
012 */
013public class Player {
014    /** Player display name (may be {@code null}). */
015    private String aName;
016
017    /** Current room occupied by the player. */
018    private Room aCurrentRoom;
019
020    /** Stack of previously visited rooms, used to support {@code back}. */
021    private Stack<Room> aPreviousRooms;
022
023    /** Items currently held by the player, keyed by a short lookup name. */
024    private ItemList aItems;
025
026    /** Current money balance used when buying items. */
027    private int aMoney;
028
029    /** Flag indicating whether the player has won the game. */
030    private boolean aHasWon;
031
032    /** Pokemon team indexed from one for battle order. */
033    private HashMap<Integer, Pokemon> aTeam;
034
035    /**
036     * Creates a player with a name and a starting room.
037     *
038     * @param pName the player name (can be empty or {@code null})
039     * @param pStartRoom the initial room
040     */
041    public Player(final String pName, final Room pStartRoom) {
042        this.aName = pName;
043        this.aCurrentRoom = pStartRoom;
044        this.aPreviousRooms = new Stack<Room>();
045        this.aItems = new ItemList();
046        this.aMoney = 150;
047        this.aHasWon = false;
048        this.aTeam = new HashMap<>();
049    } // Player()
050
051    /**
052     * Returns the player's current room.
053     *
054     * @return the current room (may be {@code null} if not initialized)
055     */
056    public Room getCurrentRoom() {
057        return this.aCurrentRoom;
058    } // getCurrentRoom()
059
060    /**
061     * Sets the current room without changing the back-stack history.
062     *
063     * @param pRoom the room to set as current
064     */
065    public void setCurrentRoom(final Room pRoom) {
066        this.aCurrentRoom = pRoom;
067    } // setCurrentRoom()
068
069    /**
070     * Changes the current room, saving the previous one to the history stack.
071     *
072     * <p>Intended to be called by the engine after validating the intended direction.
073     *
074     * @param pNextRoom the room to move to (may be {@code null})
075     */
076    public void moveTo(final Room pNextRoom) {
077        if (this.aCurrentRoom != null) {
078            this.aPreviousRooms.push(this.aCurrentRoom);
079    }
080        this.aCurrentRoom = pNextRoom;
081    } // moveTo()
082
083    /**
084     * Indicates whether the player can go back to a previous room.
085     *
086     * @return {@code true} if a previous room exists in the history stack
087     */
088    public boolean canGoBack() {
089        return !this.aPreviousRooms.isEmpty();
090    } // canGoBack()
091
092    /**
093     * Returns the previous room.
094     *
095     * @return the previous room
096     */
097    public Room getPreviousRoom() {
098        return this.aPreviousRooms.peek();
099    } // getPreviousRoom()
100
101    /**
102     * Moves back to the previous room.
103     *
104     * <p>This method assumes {@link #canGoBack()} is {@code true}. If the stack is empty, {@link
105     * Stack#pop()} will throw an exception.
106     */
107    public void goBack() {
108        this.aCurrentRoom = this.aPreviousRooms.pop();
109    } // goBack()
110
111    /**
112     * Returns the player name.
113     *
114     * @return the current name (may be {@code null})
115     */
116    public String getName() {
117        return this.aName;
118    } // getName()
119
120    /**
121     * Sets the player name.
122     *
123     * @param pName the new name (may be {@code null})
124     */
125    public void setName(final String pName) {
126        this.aName = pName;
127    } // setName()
128
129    /**
130     * Retrieves an item from the player's inventory.
131     *
132     * @param pName lookup key used when the item was added
133     * @return the matching {@link Item}, or {@code null}
134     */
135    public Item getItem(final String pName) {
136        return this.aItems.getItem(pName);
137    } // getItem()
138
139    /**
140     * Returns all items in the player's inventory.
141     *
142     * @return item keys mapped to item objects
143     */
144    public java.util.HashMap<String, Item> getItems() {
145        return this.aItems.getAllItems();
146    } // getItems()
147
148    /**
149     * Returns the stack of previous rooms.
150     *
151     * @return previous rooms used by the {@code back} command
152     */
153    public java.util.Stack<Room> getPreviousRooms() {
154        return this.aPreviousRooms;
155    } // getPreviousRooms()
156
157    /**
158     * Adds (or replaces) an item in the player's inventory.
159     *
160     * @param pName lookup key used for later retrieval
161     * @param pItem the item to store
162     */
163    public void addItem(final String pName, final Item pItem) {
164        this.aItems.addItem(pName, pItem);
165    } // addItem()
166
167    /**
168     * Removes an item from the player's inventory.
169     *
170     * @param pName lookup key of the item to remove
171     */
172    public void removeItem(final String pName) {
173        this.aItems.removeItem(pName);
174    } // removeItem()
175
176    /**
177     * Returns the player's current money balance.
178     *
179     * @return the amount of money the player has
180     */
181    public int getMoney() {
182        return this.aMoney;
183    } // getMoney()
184
185    /**
186     * Sets the player's money balance.
187     *
188     * @param pNewMoney the new amount of money
189     */
190    public void setMoney(final int pNewMoney) {
191        this.aMoney = pNewMoney;
192    } // setMoney()
193
194    /**
195     * Adds or replaces a Pokemon at the given team position.
196     *
197     * @param pPosition the team slot
198     * @param pPokemon the Pokemon to store
199     */
200    public void setPokemon(final Integer pPosition, final Pokemon pPokemon) {
201        this.aTeam.put(pPosition, pPokemon);
202    } // setPokemon()
203
204    /**
205     * Returns the Pokemon in the given team position.
206     *
207     * @param pPosition the team slot
208     * @return the matching Pokemon, or {@code null}
209     */
210    public Pokemon getPokemon(final Integer pPosition) {
211        return this.aTeam.get(pPosition);
212    } // getPokemon()
213
214    /**
215     * Returns the number of Pokemon in the player's team.
216     *
217     * @return the team size
218     */
219    public int getTeamSize() {
220        return this.aTeam.size();
221    } // getTeamSize()
222
223    /**
224     * Returns a human-readable inventory summary.
225     *
226     * @return formatted item list including total value
227     */
228    public String getItemInventory() {
229        return this.aItems.getItemList();
230    } // getItemInventory()
231
232    /**
233     * Indicates whether the player has won the game.
234     *
235     * @return {@code true} once the win condition has been completed
236     */
237    public boolean hasWon() {
238        return this.aHasWon;
239    } // hasWon()
240
241    /**
242     * Updates the player's win flag.
243     *
244     * @param pHasWon {@code true} when the player has won
245     */
246    public void setHasWon(final boolean pHasWon) {
247        this.aHasWon = pHasWon;
248    } // setHasWon()
249} // Player
